Cleaning Methods and Long-Term Maintenance for Fabric Shades

Proper maintenance helps Duette® Honeycomb Shades and Solera® Soft Shades maintain their structural form and insulating efficiency across 10 to 15 years of daily use. Both designs feature woven or non-woven polyester treated with dust-repellent, anti-static finishes that naturally shed particulates far better than traditional horizontal slats. Periodic maintenance prevents particulate buildup that can stress lift cords, internal clutches, and pleat retention.

Recommended Cleaning Procedures

  • Monthly Dry Dusting: Glide a clean microfiber feather duster or a vacuum equipped with a gentle upholstery brush side to side over the exterior vanes. For honeycomb profiles, insert a hairdryer set to cool into the side openings to clear debris or insects from the internal channels.
  • Gentle Spot Cleaning: Treat localized marks quickly by pressing a damp white cloth soaked in lukewarm water and mild liquid dish soap directly onto the blemish. Never scrub the surface, because vigorous rubbing can crush cellular creases or cause surface pilling on Solera® weaves.
  • Moisture Precautions: Never apply ammonia, bleach, or solvent-based sprays to fabric window coverings. While plain water cleans standard translucent polyester effectively, review manufacturer fabric guidelines before using moisture on blackout liners or metallized backings.
